en.sayed-ali-raza: Delay an evil because you will be able to hasten it whenever you desire.
The disregard of kinship of the ignorant is equal to the regard for kinship of the wise.
Whoever takes the world to be safe, it will betray him. Whoever regards the world as great, it will humiliate him.
Every one who shoots does not hit.
When authority changes, the time changes too.
Consult the friend before adopting a course and the neighbour before taking a house.
Beware, lest you mention in your speech what may rouse laughter even though you may be relating it from others.
